title: RetroGM, quick classic-style sports managers that run in yourbrowser. Would love feedback on the beta
author: dr_Ithan
selftext: I love deep management sims, but I don't always have 3 hours for one in-game week. RetroGM is my attempt at "deep, not tedious": real decisions (transfers, contracts, the draft, finances) with seasons that take minutes. Two games are playable now, both free in the browser: • Soccer: 4 divisions with promotion and relegation, cups, continental cups, national teams, wonderkids, stadium, up to 4 managers on one device • Basketball (new): draft lottery and scouting, trades, salary cap and free agency, live games with play by-play, awards night, God Mode and custom league files No account, works offline once loaded, saves stay on your device. [https://retrogm.com](https://retrogm.com) What would make you keep playing for "one more season"?
